states.PASS: A governed validator/compiler executed and closed the applicable gate.
states.READY: Prerequisites close and the next authorized operation may execute.
states.HELD: Required authority or evidence is absent but no invariant was violated.
states.BLOCKED: An applicable required upstream gate failed or remains unresolved.
states.NOT_AUTHORIZED: The upstream authority explicitly does not grant this permission; technical readiness cannot promote it.
states.NOT_INSTANTIATED: No concrete governed unit/artifact exists to validate.
states.NOT_APPLICABLE: The architecture says the gate does not apply to this scope.
states.NOT_RUN: The gate applies but execution has not occurred.
states.NOT_ISSUED: A receipt cannot be issued because its governed unit does not exist.
